settings.heading: FORMATS, PROPORTIONS & CARE.
settings.subtext: Understanding bottle scale, oil concentration, preservation, and Class 3 fine-fragrance delivery ensures every QIRÉLIA flacon performs with clarity from first mist to last.

settings.title: 01 / APPLICATION & STORAGE
settings.body: Mist once or twice onto pulse points from 15 cm and let top notes settle undisturbed without rubbing wrists. Store flacons upright in a cool, dry place away from direct window sunlight and bathroom steam. Subtle natural deepening of liquid hue is normal due to zero synthetic dyes.

settings.title: 02 / CLASS 3 FRAGRANCE SHIPPING
settings.body: Because fine Eau de Parfum and Extrait de Parfum contain perfumery-grade alcohol, orders ship via approved Ground / Limited Quantity (Class 3 UN1266) courier services. Due to carrier safety rules, we cannot deliver to PO Boxes or APO/FPO military addresses. Shipping rates calculate by packed weight at checkout.

settings.title: 03 / SEALED RETURNS & DAMAGED GLASS
settings.body: For hygiene and safety integrity, returns are accepted only on completely unopened flacons with their original factory cellophane tamper seal intact. If glass arrives damaged in transit, contact care@qirelia.com within 48 hours with photographs for immediate replacement—no return of leaking glass required.
